name: configured-library-authoritative
body: When `kalide.yaml` sets the top-level key `templates:`, that path is the deck's template library and the sole template root for the session: it is resolved as written (relative to the deck root, or absolute), and a configured path that is missing, not a directory, or not a valid library is a templates error naming that path. A local `templates/` is consulted only when the key is absent. kalide never substitutes one library root for another: there is no fallback from a configured path to a local `templates/`, and no silent retarget while serving (template-retarget-requires-restart).
